sources.name: Station
sources.review: Dark/light proposal inspected. 1 is exterior matte; 2/5 are openings between sign uprights; 3/4 are canopy openings; 6/7 are pump-hose openings; 8-17 are isolated neutral matte gaps at vegetation/pillar/sign edges near y705-759. Warm canopy chips, pale plaster, pump labels, dark shop recesses and rocks stay opaque. Edge RGB preparation is separate from this silhouette decision; it must be inspected again on both backdrops. This is an agent-reviewed art study, not user approval or runtime readiness.
